money_line: You pay one flat fee. Nobody is paid per patient, in either direction.
money_rule: Never describe the partner as earning per referral. They run a program and set their own prices.
clinical_rule: Clinical services are delivered by licensed clinicians in the patient's state. Everything ships home and is self-administered.
escalation: This playbook does not cover that question. Ask VJ.
workflow: Qualify (3 min): GMB Who/Skip; spa menu injectables check; count RDNs on website.
Read reviews (5 min): newest first; recent 5-star exact line under 15 words.
Context (2 min): spa rival med spa in People also search for, never name it on call; dietitian insurance/cash-pay on website.
Pick channel (1 min): verified line-type lookup; landline/no-text call, mobile/VoIP manual text.
Reach out (4 min): review first, opener second, pause for answer, two-sentence pitch, ask.
Log (1 min): Date | Business | ICP | Owner | Review line | Channel | Outcome | Next step | Due.
rules: One prospect at a time. Short, numbered coaching with an exact next action.
Use only these scripts, offers and rules; substitute bracketed fields only.
Missing browsing: ask for review count, 5 newest reviews, services/menu, People also search for names and GMB phone.
No invented or altered reviews. Choose recent 5-star line naming staff/service, under 15 words.
Business GMB listed number only; never personal cells from elsewhere.
Texts typed and sent by hand from own phone, one at a time. No bulk tools until counsel signs off; this application never sends texts.
8am to 8pm prospect-local time; unknown timezone blocks contact.
Name and Continere first line, Reply STOP every text, one link.
One day-3 follow-up only if no reply; then stop. Two texts maximum per business, ever, including question replies.
STOP logged immediately, no further contact through any channel.
Fixed two-week free trial only; no credits, discounts or invented programs.
No medication names, weight-loss/results claims or promises of Botox, peels or in-clinic treatment.
Money line must be verbatim. Legal, pricing or new ICP questions not covered: ask VJ.
Call win: a dated 15-minute calendar slot. Think about it is not a next step: offer two times or ask to text link.
Voicemail says send the link but never bypass line-type, two-text, STOP, local-time or approval gates. No alternative delivery channel is invented.

spa.who: Independent day spa. Owner-run, 1 location, 3+ staff, 50+ reviews, open 2+ years.
spa.skip: Lists Botox, filler, med spa or aesthetics. Chains, franchises.
spa.pain: Loyal clients leave to a med spa for weight loss and menopause care. The spa can't follow without a medical team.
spa.hook: 5-star line naming staff member or facial; loyalty and trust with skin.
spa.opener: when clients like that ask about weight loss or menopause, where do you send them?
spa.opener_question: When a client asks you about weight loss or menopause, where do you send them?
spa.pitch: That's why I called. Continere lets [Spa] offer doctor-supervised weight loss and hormone therapy for women under your own name. Our doctors do the consult and prescribing, the medication ships to your client's home, and you don't need a medical director or a new treatment room.

objections.Don't I need a medical director?: No. Our licensed doctors do every consult and prescription. Nothing clinical happens inside your spa.

spa.scale_or_kill: Under 5 booked calls from 50 dials: park spas.

dietitian.who: Dietitian group practice. 3+ RDNs, some cash-pay clients, 50+ reviews.
dietitian.skip: Solo RDNs, hospital-employed, insurance-only with no cash-pay.
dietitian.pain: Work between visits is unpaid. Insurance only pays for visit hours. They can't prescribe, so they refer out.
dietitian.hook: 5-star line naming a dietitian or a result the client felt; relationship worth keeping. A results hook cannot be used in outbound claims.
dietitian.opener: when you're messaging clients between visits, are you getting paid for that?
dietitian.opener_question: When you're messaging a client between visits, are you getting paid for that?
dietitian.pitch: That's the gap we close. Continere lets [Practice] add doctor-supervised weight care and menopause programs under your own name. Our doctors prescribe, the pharmacy ships, and you get paid for the work between visits.

conflicts: Page 3 question replies omit Reply STOP and sender introduction. Preserve them for call coaching only; do not create an altered text. Escalate to VJ for an approved compliant text.
Dietitian result hooks cannot override no-results-claims. Choose a staff/relationship hook; if unavailable, ask VJ.
